lessons.summary: Nguyên nhân: because / as / since / now that + MỆNH ĐỀ ↔ because of / due to / owing to / on account of + DANH TỪ / V-ing. Tương phản: although / even though / though / while / whereas + MỆNH ĐỀ ↔ despite / in spite of + DANH TỪ / V-ing. Khi bí, dùng "the fact that + mệnh đề". Nối hai câu: however, nevertheless, on the other hand.

blocks.caption: Mệnh đề (S + V) ↔ cụm danh từ – dạng biến đổi rất hay gặp trong đề thi

steps.t: The match was canceled because it rained heavily.
↓ because + mệnh đề → because of + cụm danh từ
The match was canceled because of the heavy rain.
↓ although + mệnh đề
Although it rained heavily, they kept playing.
↓ despite + cụm danh từ
Despite the heavy rain, they kept playing.

rows.label: Nguyên nhân + cụm danh từ

parts.t: because of / due to / owing to

rows.ex: The flight was delayed [[because of strong winds]].

rows.label: Nguyên nhân + mệnh đề
rows.ex: [[Now that]] I have a car, I rarely take the bus.

rows.label: Tương phản + mệnh đề
rows.ex: [[Although]] the hotel was expensive, the service was poor.

rows.label: Tương phản + cụm danh từ
rows.ex: [[Despite feeling tired]], she finished the report.

rows.label: … the fact that + mệnh đề
rows.ex: [[Despite the fact that]] it was raining, the event went ahead.

rows.label: Đối lập hai vế
rows.ex: Some people prefer cities, [[whereas]] others enjoy rural life.

items.title: As / since: lý do người nghe đã biết, thường đứng đầu câu
items.ex: [[As]] it was getting late, we decided to take a taxi.
items.vi: Vì trời đã muộn, chúng tôi quyết định đi taxi.

items.title: Due to thường đứng sau be; owing to trang trọng hơn because of
items.ex: The delay was [[due to]] a technical problem.
items.vi: Sự chậm trễ là do một sự cố kỹ thuật.

items.title: Even though nhấn mạnh hơn although (dù thực tế là…)
items.ex: [[Even though]] he had studied hard, he failed the test.
items.vi: Dù đã học rất chăm, anh ấy vẫn trượt.

items.title: However / Nevertheless: trạng từ nối HAI câu, theo sau là dấu phẩy
items.ex: The plan was expensive. [[However]], it was approved.
items.vi: Kế hoạch tốn kém. Tuy nhiên, nó vẫn được duyệt.

items.title: On the other hand: nêu mặt còn lại của vấn đề
items.ex: Cities offer more jobs. [[On the other hand]], they are often polluted.
items.vi: Thành phố có nhiều việc làm hơn. Mặt khác, chúng thường ô nhiễm.

head: Nghĩa
+ Mệnh đề (S + V)
+ Cụm danh từ / V-ing
rows: because, as, since, now that, due to the fact that
because of, due to, owing to, on account of
although, even though, though, despite the fact that
However, … / Nevertheless, … / On the other hand, …

head: Mệnh đề
Cụm từ tương đương
rows: because of his illness / because of being ill
despite her youth / despite being young
in spite of the heavy rain
despite their efforts / despite trying hard

blocks.text: Bốn cách đổi mệnh đề → cụm danh từ: (1) tính từ + danh từ (it was cold → the cold weather); (2) tính từ sở hữu + danh từ (he was absent → his absence); (3) V-ing khi CÙNG chủ ngữ (she was tired → being tired); (4) the fact that + mệnh đề – cách an toàn khi không tìm được danh từ.
Although / because nối hai mệnh đề trong MỘT câu; however / therefore nối HAI câu. Không dùng although và but trong cùng một câu, và không viết "despite of".

blocks.wrong: Despite of the rain, we went out.
blocks.right: Despite the rain, we went out.
blocks.why: Despite không có of (in spite of mới có of).

blocks.wrong: Although he was tired, but he kept working.
blocks.right: Although he was tired, he kept working.
blocks.why: Không dùng although và but cùng lúc.

blocks.wrong: Because of the traffic was heavy, I was late.
blocks.right: Because the traffic was heavy, I was late.
blocks.why: Sau because of là cụm danh từ; có mệnh đề (S + V) thì dùng because.

blocks.wrong: In spite of she was ill, she went to work.
blocks.right: In spite of being ill, she went to work.
blocks.why: In spite of + V-ing / N; hoặc in spite of the fact that she was ill.

blocks.text: Task 2: dùng while / whereas để so sánh hai quan điểm, although / despite the fact that để nhượng bộ trước khi phản biện, owing to / due to cho văn phong trang trọng. Xen kẽ mệnh đề và cụm danh từ giúp tăng Grammatical Range.
blocks.ex: [[Although]] online learning offers flexibility, many students still benefit from face-to-face interaction.

quiz.q: The match was postponed ___ the heavy snow.
quiz.explain: Sau chỗ trống là cụm danh từ, nghĩa nguyên nhân → due to the heavy snow. because cần mệnh đề; although và despite chỉ tương phản.

quiz.q: ___ the high cost, many families still choose private schools.
quiz.explain: Cụm danh từ (the high cost) + nghĩa tương phản → Despite. Although và Even though cần mệnh đề; Because of chỉ nguyên nhân.

quiz.q: ___ he had a map, he got lost in the old town.
quiz.explain: Sau chỗ trống là mệnh đề (he had a map) + nghĩa tương phản → Even though. Despite và In spite of cần danh từ/V-ing; Due to chỉ nguyên nhân.

quiz.q: Some students learn best by reading, ___ others prefer hands-on activities.
quiz.explain: Đối lập hai vế (người thích đọc / người thích thực hành) → whereas. despite và because of cần danh từ; so chỉ kết quả.

quiz.q: ___ you have finished your exams, you can relax a bit.
quiz.explain: Now that + mệnh đề = vì bây giờ đã… → Now that you have finished. Due to, In spite of, Because of đều phải đi với danh từ, không đi với mệnh đề.

quiz.q: The new policy is popular. ___, it is very expensive to implement.
quiz.explain: Nối hai câu, nghĩa tương phản → However, đứng đầu câu sau có dấu phẩy. Although nối trong cùng một câu; Despite cần danh từ; Because chỉ nguyên nhân.

quiz.q: Câu nào đúng?
options: Although it was late, we kept talking.
Although it was late, but we kept talking.
Despite it was late, we kept talking.
In spite of it was late, we kept talking.
quiz.explain: Although + mệnh đề, không dùng kèm but → Although it was late, we kept talking. Câu 2 thừa but; Despite và In spite of không đi trực tiếp với mệnh đề.

quiz.q: Câu nào đúng?
options: Due to he was sick, he stayed home.
Due to sick, he stayed home.
Due to the fact that he was sick, he stayed home.
Due to of his sickness, he stayed home.
quiz.explain: Due to the fact that + mệnh đề → Due to the fact that he was sick. "Due to he was sick" đặt mệnh đề sau giới từ; "Due to sick" thiếu danh từ; "Due to of" thừa of.

quiz.q: Câu nào đúng?
options: Despite of the noise, I slept well.
Despite the noise, I slept well.
In spite the noise, I slept well.
Despite there was noise, I slept well.
quiz.explain: Despite + danh từ (không có of) → Despite the noise. "Despite of" thừa of; "In spite the noise" thiếu of; "Despite there was" đặt mệnh đề sau despite.

quiz.q: Câu nào cùng nghĩa? "Although she was nervous, she gave an excellent speech."
options: Despite nervous, she gave an excellent speech.
Because of her nerves, she gave an excellent speech.
In spite she was nervous, she gave an excellent speech.
Despite being nervous, she gave an excellent speech.
quiz.explain: Cùng chủ ngữ → despite + being + tính từ → Despite being nervous. "Despite nervous" thiếu being; "Because of" đổi quan hệ thành nguyên nhân; "In spite she was" thiếu of và đặt mệnh đề sau.

quiz.q: Câu nào cùng nghĩa? "The road was closed because it had flooded."
options: The road was closed due to flooding.
The road was closed despite the flooding.
The road was closed because of flood it.
The road was closed although flooding.
quiz.explain: because + mệnh đề ↔ due to + cụm danh từ → due to flooding. despite và although đổi nghĩa thành tương phản; "because of flood it" sai cấu trúc.

quiz.q: Câu nào cùng nghĩa? "Despite his lack of experience, he got the job."
options: Because he had no experience, he got the job.
He got the job, so he lacked experience.
Although he lacked experience, he got the job.
He lacked experience; therefore, he got the job.
quiz.explain: Despite + N ↔ although + mệnh đề, giữ nghĩa tương phản. Because, so và therefore đổi quan hệ thành nguyên nhân – kết quả, sai logic.

drills.q: ___ spite of the cold weather, they went swimming in the sea.
a: in
drills.ex: In spite of + danh từ/V-ing = mặc dù → In spite of the cold weather.

drills.q: Some people love city life, ___ others prefer the peace of the countryside.
a: whereas
while
drills.ex: Đối lập hai vế: whereas / while.

drills.q: The concert was canceled on account ___ the storm.
a: of
drills.ex: on account of + danh từ = because of (vì, do) → on account of the storm.

drills.q: Although it was raining, the match continued.
a: Despite the rain, the match continued.
Despite the fact that it was raining, the match continued.
Despite it raining, the match continued.
drills.ex: Although + mệnh đề → despite + cụm danh từ / the fact that.

drills.q: Because he was ill, he missed the exam.
a: Because of his illness, he missed the exam.
Because of being ill, he missed the exam.
drills.ex: Because + mệnh đề → because of + cụm danh từ / V-ing.

drills.q: In spite of his lack of experience, he got the job.
a: Although he lacked experience, he got the job.
Although he had no experience, he got the job.
Although he did not have experience, he got the job.
Although he did not have any experience, he got the job.
Although he was inexperienced, he got the job.
Although he had little experience, he got the job.
drills.ex: In spite of + N → although + mệnh đề.

drills.q: The tickets were expensive. We bought them anyway.
a: Even though the tickets were expensive, we bought them.
Even though the tickets were expensive, we bought them anyway.
drills.ex: Even though + mệnh đề nhượng bộ.

drills.q: Traffic was heavy. We arrived on time.
a: In spite of the heavy traffic, we arrived on time.
In spite of the fact that traffic was heavy, we arrived on time.
In spite of the fact that the traffic was heavy, we arrived on time.
drills.ex: In spite of + cụm danh từ (the heavy traffic).
Không dùng although và but trong cùng một câu.
Despite không có of (hoặc dùng In spite of).

drills.q: Write about a plan that changed because of the weather or traffic.
a: Because of the heavy rain, we stayed at home.
The flight was delayed due to the storm.
drills.ex: because of / due to + danh từ (cụm danh từ); because + mệnh đề.

drills.q: Write about two people or places that are different.
a: My sister loves sport, whereas I prefer reading.
Despite the cold weather, we went to the beach.
drills.ex: Tương phản → whereas + mệnh đề; despite + danh từ/V-ing (không + mệnh đề).

lessons.title: As if, It's time, would rather + quá khứ giả định
lessons.en: As if, It's Time, Would Rather & the Unreal Past
lessons.summary: Khi nói điều KHÔNG có thật hoặc mong muốn, ta lùi thì: as if / as though + quá khứ (hiện tại không thật) hoặc quá khứ hoàn thành (quá khứ không thật); It's (high / about) time + S + V2; would rather + S2 + V2 (hiện tại) / had V3 (quá khứ); If only + V2 / had V3. Cùng nguyên tắc với wish.

blocks.caption: As if: thì thường = có thể đúng; lùi thì = không có thật

steps.t: He looks as if he is tired. (có thể anh ấy mệt thật)
↓ biết rõ là không thật → lùi một thì
He talks as if he knew everything. (thật ra không biết hết)
↓ không thật trong quá khứ → had + V3
She talked about Paris as if she had lived there. (chưa từng sống ở đó)

rows.label: As if – không thật ở hiện tại
rows.ex: He talks [[as if he knew]] everything.

rows.label: As if – không thật trong quá khứ
rows.ex: She looked [[as if she had seen]] a ghost.

rows.label: It's time + to V
rows.ex: [[It's time for us to leave]].

rows.label: It's (high / about) time + S + V2
rows.ex: [[It's high time the government took]] action on housing.

rows.label: Would rather (cùng chủ ngữ)
rows.ex: I [[would rather stay]] at home tonight.

rows.label: Would rather + người khác (hiện tại / tương lai)
rows.ex: I [[would rather you didn't smoke]] in here.

rows.label: Would rather + người khác (quá khứ)
rows.ex: I [[would rather you had told]] me the truth.

rows.label: If only
rows.ex: [[If only I had]] more free time!

items.title: As if + thì bình thường: điều có thể đúng (dựa vào dấu hiệu)
items.ex: It looks [[as if it is going to rain]].
items.vi: Trông có vẻ trời sắp mưa.

items.title: As if + quá khứ đơn: tưởng tượng, trái với hiện tại
items.ex: She treats me [[as if I were]] a child.
items.vi: Cô ấy đối xử với tôi như thể tôi là trẻ con.

items.title: As if + quá khứ hoàn thành: trái với sự thật đã xảy ra
items.ex: He acted [[as if nothing had happened]].
items.vi: Anh ta cư xử như thể chưa có chuyện gì xảy ra.

items.title: It's time + S + V2: lẽ ra đã phải làm rồi (hàm ý phàn nàn, thúc giục)
items.ex: [[It's time you went]] to bed.
items.vi: Đến giờ con phải đi ngủ rồi đấy.

items.title: Would rather + S2 + V2: muốn người khác làm gì
items.ex: My parents [[would rather I studied]] medicine.
items.vi: Bố mẹ tôi muốn tôi học ngành y hơn.

items.title: If only = I wish nhưng cảm xúc mạnh hơn
items.ex: [[If only I had listened]] to your advice!
items.vi: Giá mà tôi đã nghe lời khuyên của bạn!

head: Cấu trúc
Không thật ở hiện tại / tương lai
Không thật trong quá khứ
rows: S + V2 (hoặc for sb + to V)

blocks.text: Trong as if / if only / wish / would rather, "were" dùng được cho mọi ngôi trong văn trang trọng (as if he were…); văn nói thường dùng was.
Liên hệ bài Câu điều kiện hỗn hợp & wish: I wish I knew = If only I knew – cùng nguyên tắc lùi thì. Would rather + V nguyên mẫu (cùng chủ ngữ) KHÔNG lùi thì: I'd rather walk.
Anh – Mỹ văn nói rất hay dùng like thay cho as if: He acts like he owns the place. It looks like it's going to rain. Trong bài viết trang trọng và bài thi, dùng as if / as though.

blocks.wrong: I'd rather you don't tell anyone.
blocks.right: I'd rather you didn't tell anyone.
blocks.why: Would rather + người khác → động từ lùi về quá khứ dù nói về hiện tại/tương lai.

blocks.wrong: It's time we go home.
blocks.right: It's time we went home.
blocks.why: It's time + S + V2 (quá khứ giả định).

blocks.wrong: I would rather to walk than take a taxi.
blocks.right: I would rather walk than take a taxi.
blocks.why: Would rather + V nguyên mẫu không có to.

blocks.wrong: He behaves as if he is the boss, but he isn't.
blocks.right: He behaves as if he were the boss, but he isn't.
blocks.why: Biết rõ là không thật → lùi thì (were).

blocks.text: Speaking: "I'd rather…" là cách tự nhiên để nói về sở thích (Part 1). Writing Task 2: "It is high time (that) governments + V2" nêu mạnh một đề xuất cấp thiết.
blocks.ex: [[It is high time that governments invested]] more in renewable energy.

quiz.q: He spends money as if he ___ a millionaire. (thật ra anh ấy không giàu)
quiz.explain: Điều không có thật ở hiện tại (thật ra không giàu) → as if + lùi thì: were. is và will be diễn tả điều có thật; has been sai thì. (Văn nói, nhất là Anh – Mỹ, đôi khi vẫn nghe "as if he is/was…", nhưng khi biết rõ là không thật, bài thi và văn viết dùng were/was.)

quiz.q: She described the city as if she ___ there, but she had never visited it.
quiz.explain: Điều không có thật trong quá khứ (chưa từng đến) → as if + had + V3 → had been. has been, was being, would be không diễn tả quá khứ không có thật.

quiz.q: It's about time you ___ a job.
quiz.explain: It's about time + S + V2 (đã đến lúc… – hàm ý lẽ ra phải làm rồi) → found. find và will find không lùi thì; finding sai dạng.

quiz.q: It's time ___ the meeting.
quiz.explain: It's time + to V (đến lúc làm gì, không có chủ ngữ riêng) → to start. Nếu có chủ ngữ thì dùng It's time + S + V2.

quiz.q: I'd rather you ___ your phone during dinner.
quiz.explain: would rather + S2 + V2 (phủ định: didn't + V) → I'd rather you didn't use. "don't use" và "won't use" không lùi thì; "not use" thiếu trợ động từ.

quiz.q: I'd rather ___ at home than go to the party.
quiz.explain: Cùng chủ ngữ: would rather + V nguyên mẫu (… than + V) → I'd rather stay. Không dùng to V, V-ing hay V2 sau would rather khi cùng chủ ngữ.

quiz.q: Câu nào đúng?
options: I'd rather you told me about it yesterday.
I'd rather you have told me about it yesterday.
I'd rather you had told me about it yesterday.
I'd rather you tell me about it yesterday.
quiz.explain: Mong muốn trái với quá khứ → would rather + S2 + had V3. told nói về hiện tại; "have told" và "tell" không lùi thì.

quiz.q: Câu nào đúng?
options: If only I knew the answer!
If only I know the answer!
If only I will know the answer!
If only I am knowing the answer!
quiz.explain: If only + V2 cho điều ước không có thật ở hiện tại → If only I knew the answer! know, will know, am knowing không lùi thì nên không diễn tả điều ước.

quiz.q: Câu nào đúng?
options: It's high time the city builds more parks.
It's high time the city has built more parks.
It's high time the city to build more parks.
It's high time the city built more parks.
quiz.explain: It's high time + S + V2 (quá khứ đơn, dù nói về hiện tại) → the city built. builds và has built không lùi thì; "to build" thiếu for.

quiz.q: Câu nào cùng nghĩa? "I want you to stay here tonight."
options: I'd rather you stayed here tonight.
I'd rather you to stay here tonight.
I'd rather you had stayed here tonight.
quiz.explain: Muốn người khác làm gì → would rather + S2 + V2 → I'd rather you stayed. "I'd rather stay" đổi người thực hiện; "you to stay" sai cấu trúc; "had stayed" nói về quá khứ.

quiz.q: Câu nào cùng nghĩa? "He isn't the manager, but he gives orders like one."
options: He gives orders as if he is not the manager.
He gives orders as if he had been the manager.
He gives orders as though being the manager.
He gives orders as if he were the manager.
quiz.explain: Không có thật ở hiện tại (anh ấy không phải quản lý) → as if + were → as if he were the manager. Câu 1 đảo nghĩa; "had been" chỉ quá khứ; "as though being" sai cấu trúc.

quiz.q: Câu nào cùng nghĩa? "I regret not studying harder."
options: If only I had studied harder.
quiz.explain: Hối tiếc về quá khứ → If only + had V3 → If only I had studied harder. "studied" là ước cho hiện tại; "study" không lùi thì; "It's time I studied" là lời khuyên nên làm ngay.

drills.q: He acts as if he ___ the owner of the company, but he is only an intern. (be)
a: were
was
drills.ex: Không thật ở hiện tại → lùi thì: were (trang trọng) / was.

drills.q: It's high time we ___ home. It's nearly midnight. (go)
a: went
drills.ex: It's high time + S + V2 (đã đến lúc phải…) → we went.

drills.q: I'd rather you ___ me the truth yesterday. (tell)
a: had told
'd told
drills.ex: Mong muốn trái với quá khứ → had + V3.

drills.q: You should go to bed now; it's late.
a: It's time you went to bed.
It's time you went to bed now.
drills.ex: Lời khuyên "nên làm ngay" → It's time + S + V2: It's time you went to bed.

drills.q: I want you to stay here tonight.
a: I'd rather you stayed here tonight.
drills.ex: Muốn người khác làm gì: would rather + S2 + V2 (quá khứ giả định) → I'd rather you stayed here tonight.

drills.q: I prefer walking to taking the bus.
a: I'd rather walk than take the bus.
drills.ex: Would rather + V nguyên mẫu + than + V nguyên mẫu.

drills.q: She isn't a celebrity. But she behaves like one.
a: She behaves as if she were a celebrity.
She behaves as if she was a celebrity.
drills.ex: Không thật ở hiện tại → as if + were/was.

drills.q: I didn't listen to my teacher. I regret it now.
a: If only I had listened to my teacher.
If only I'd listened to my teacher.
If only I had listened to my teacher!
drills.ex: Hối tiếc quá khứ → If only + had V3.
Would rather + S2 → động từ lùi về quá khứ.
It's about time + S + V2 (đã đến lúc…) → the council repaired, không dùng hiện tại repairs.

drills.q: Describe someone who acts as if something were true.
a: My cousin talks as if he knew everything.
She looks as if she hasn't slept for days.
drills.ex: as if + quá khứ (knew, were) cho điều không có thật; as if + hiện tại khi có thể đúng.

drills.q: Tell someone it is time to do something.
a: It's time you went to bed.
I'd rather you didn't use my phone.
drills.ex: It's time + S + V2 và would rather + S + V2 dùng quá khứ để nói về hiện tại.

lessons.title: Thành ngữ & văn phong
lessons.summary: Văn phong (register) quyết định chọn từ: Writing cần trang trọng – từ một chữ thay cụm động từ thân mật (find out → discover), không rút gọn (do not), câu khách quan (It could be argued that…), tránh thành ngữ sáo rỗng. Speaking cho phép thân mật hơn, và 1–2 thành ngữ tự nhiên, đúng ngữ cảnh sẽ giúp tăng điểm Lexical Resource.

blocks.caption: Cùng một ý – mức độ trang trọng khác nhau
Nâng văn phong một câu từ văn nói lên văn viết học thuật

steps.t: Kids these days get loads of homework.
↓ thay từ lóng / thân mật bằng từ trang trọng
Children nowadays receive a considerable amount of homework.
↓ chuyển sang câu khách quan (impersonal)
It could be argued that children today are given excessive homework.

rows.label: Ý kiến cá nhân → khách quan
rows.ex: [[It could be argued that]] technology has made people less patient.

rows.label: There is + bằng chứng / mối lo ngại
rows.ex: [[There is growing concern that]] young people spend too long online.

rows.label: Bị động khách quan
rows.ex: Regular exercise [[is widely believed to improve]] mental health.

head: Thân mật (Speaking)
Trang trọng (Writing)
Ví dụ trang trọng
rows: Applicants must obtain a visa in advance.
Researchers discovered a link between diet and sleep.
a considerable number of / a great deal of
A considerable number of graduates move abroad.
The committee will investigate the complaint.
The conference was postponed until May.
The aim is to eliminate unnecessary paperwork.
Smoking has a harmful effect on health.
renewable sources such as wind and solar power

items.title: a piece of cake – rất dễ
items.ex: The first part of the test was [[a piece of cake]].
items.vi: Phần đầu bài kiểm tra dễ như ăn bánh.

items.title: once in a blue moon – rất hiếm khi
items.ex: I eat fast food [[once in a blue moon]].
items.vi: Hiếm lắm tôi mới ăn đồ ăn nhanh.

items.title: hit the books – học hành chăm chỉ
items.ex: I need to [[hit the books]] before my exam next week.
items.vi: Tôi cần học chăm trước kỳ thi tuần sau.

items.title: under the weather – hơi mệt, không khỏe
items.ex: I was feeling a bit [[under the weather]] last weekend.
items.vi: Cuối tuần trước tôi thấy hơi mệt.

items.title: over the moon – vô cùng vui sướng
items.ex: My mom was [[over the moon]] when I passed my driving test.
items.vi: Mẹ tôi vui mừng khôn xiết khi tôi thi đỗ bằng lái.

items.title: cost an arm and a leg – rất đắt
items.ex: Renting a flat in the city center [[costs an arm and a leg]].
items.vi: Thuê căn hộ ở trung tâm thành phố đắt cắt cổ.

items.title: on the same page – cùng quan điểm, hiểu ý nhau
items.ex: My friends and I are usually [[on the same page]] about music.
items.vi: Tôi và bạn bè thường hợp gu âm nhạc.

items.title: a breath of fresh air – điều mới mẻ, dễ chịu
items.ex: The new teacher was [[a breath of fresh air]] for our class.
items.vi: Thầy giáo mới như một làn gió mới với lớp tôi.

items.title: up to my ears (in work) – ngập đầu công việc
items.ex: I am [[up to my ears]] in work at the moment.
items.vi: Dạo này tôi ngập đầu trong công việc.

items.title: learn the ropes – học những điều cơ bản của một công việc
items.ex: It took me a few weeks to [[learn the ropes]] at my new job.
items.vi: Tôi mất vài tuần để làm quen với công việc mới.

items.title: go the extra mile – nỗ lực hơn mức cần thiết
items.ex: The staff at that hotel always [[go the extra mile]] for guests.
items.vi: Nhân viên khách sạn đó luôn tận tâm hơn mong đợi.

items.title: take something with a pinch of salt (Anh – Mỹ: with a grain of salt) – không tin hoàn toàn
items.ex: I take online reviews [[with a pinch of salt]].
items.vi: Tôi không tin hoàn toàn vào các đánh giá trên mạng.

blocks.text: Rút gọn (contractions): Writing Task 1 & 2 viết đầy đủ do not, it is, cannot, will not thay vì don't, it's, can't, won't. Trong Speaking, dạng rút gọn là tự nhiên và nên dùng.

Phrasal verb không bị cấm trong Writing – carry out, set up, point out, rely on đều trang trọng. Nhưng khi có động từ một chữ tương đương, hãy ưu tiên: look into → investigate, put up with → tolerate, come up with → devise / propose.

blocks.wrong: Kids nowadays get way too much homework.
blocks.right: Children nowadays are given an excessive amount of homework.
blocks.why: Writing: tránh kids, get, way too much – dùng từ vựng trang trọng.

blocks.wrong: Pollution is a big problem and governments should do something about it ASAP.
blocks.right: Pollution is a serious problem, and governments should take action as soon as possible.
blocks.why: Tránh từ viết tắt (ASAP) và cụm mơ hồ (do something) trong văn học thuật.

blocks.wrong: Every cloud has a silver lining, so unemployment can be good.
blocks.right: Although unemployment has serious drawbacks, it may encourage some people to retrain.
blocks.why: Thành ngữ sáo rỗng trong Task 2 bị coi là thiếu học thuật; hãy diễn đạt ý cụ thể.

blocks.wrong: The government can't ignore this issue, and it's time to act.
blocks.right: The government cannot ignore this issue, and it is time to act.
blocks.why: Không dùng dạng rút gọn trong bài viết học thuật.

blocks.text: Speaking: dùng 1–2 thành ngữ tự nhiên, đúng ngữ cảnh để tăng Lexical Resource; dùng gượng ép hoặc sai nghĩa sẽ bị trừ điểm. Writing Task 2: tránh thành ngữ sáo rỗng (every cloud has a silver lining, at the end of the day), tránh từ lóng và dạng rút gọn; ưu tiên câu khách quan.
blocks.ex: [[It is widely accepted that]] regular exercise [[has a positive effect on]] mental health.

quiz.q: Chọn từ trang trọng nhất cho bài Writing: "Researchers wanted to ___ why the birds had left."
quiz.explain: Discover là động từ một chữ, trang trọng hơn find out. find out, figure out và suss out là cụm động từ thân mật.

quiz.q: Chọn cách mở câu phù hợp Writing Task 2: "___ that university education should be free."
quiz.explain: Câu khách quan It could be argued that… phù hợp văn học thuật. I reckon, Loads of people say và To be honest đều là văn nói.

quiz.q: The government should ___ the amount of plastic waste. (văn trang trọng)
quiz.explain: Văn trang trọng (Writing) nên dùng động từ một chữ → reduce. cut down và cut down on là cụm động từ thân mật (cut down còn sai nghĩa "chặt"); "get rid" thiếu of.

quiz.q: "I'm feeling a bit under the weather today." nghĩa là:
options: Tôi thích thời tiết hôm nay
Tôi thấy hơi mệt, không khỏe
quiz.explain: under the weather (thành ngữ) = hơi mệt, không khỏe. Thành ngữ không mang nghĩa đen về thời tiết hay mưa, cũng không có nghĩa là vui.

quiz.q: "Eating out in this city costs an arm and a leg." nghĩa là:
quiz.explain: cost an arm and a leg (thành ngữ) = rất đắt. Thành ngữ không nói về độ rẻ, độ ngon hay sự nguy hiểm.

quiz.q: Cụm nào nên TRÁNH trong Writing Task 2?
options: at the end of the day
quiz.explain: at the end of the day là cụm văn nói sáo rỗng, nên tránh trong Writing Task 2. a considerable number of, consequently và it is widely believed that đều phù hợp văn học thuật.

quiz.q: Câu nào phù hợp nhất cho Writing Task 2?
options: Kids get loads of stuff from ads.
Kids are like totally influenced by ads.
Children are heavily influenced by advertising.
Ads mess with kids' heads big time.
quiz.explain: Dùng từ vựng trang trọng: children, heavily influenced, advertising. Ba câu còn lại dùng từ lóng/thân mật (loads of stuff, totally, mess with).

quiz.q: Câu nào phù hợp nhất cho Writing Task 1?
options: The number of visitors rose significantly in 2015.
The number of visitors went up a lot in 2015.
Visitor numbers kind of jumped in 2015.
quiz.explain: Rose significantly trang trọng và chính xác hơn went up a lot. went up a lot, loads more và kind of jumped là văn nói.

quiz.q: Câu nào dùng thành ngữ ĐÚNG ngữ cảnh (Speaking)?
options: I was over the moon when my phone broke.
I was over the moon when I got my exam results.
My hometown is a piece of cake.
I hit the books when I went to the beach.
quiz.explain: Over the moon = rất vui → hợp với tin vui như có kết quả thi tốt. over the moon không hợp với tin xấu; "a piece of cake" và "hit the books" dùng sai ngữ cảnh.

quiz.q: Câu nào cùng nghĩa, văn phong trang trọng hơn? "Lots of people think the internet is bad for kids."
options: Tons of people think the net is bad for kids.
People reckon the internet is rubbish for kids.
A lot of folks say the internet is bad for kids.
Many people believe that the internet is harmful to children.
quiz.explain: Many people believe / harmful / children là từ vựng trang trọng. tons of, reckon, folks đều là văn nói thân mật.

quiz.q: Câu nào cùng nghĩa, trang trọng hơn? "The company put off the meeting."
quiz.explain: Put off = postpone (hoãn), không phải cancel (hủy). cancel là hủy (khác hoãn); call và hold là triệu tập/tổ chức.

quiz.q: Câu nào cùng nghĩa? "I only eat sweets once in a blue moon."
options: I eat sweets when I feel sad.
quiz.explain: once in a blue moon = rất hiếm khi → I very rarely eat sweets. Các phương án còn lại nói về tần suất thường xuyên hoặc thời điểm, sai nghĩa.

drills.q: Researchers are trying to ___ the main cause of the disease. (DISCOVERY)
a: discover
drills.ex: Cần động từ (sau to): discover – trang trọng hơn find out.

drills.q: Air pollution can have a ___ effect on children's health. (HARM)
a: harmful
drills.ex: Cần tính từ trước danh từ effect: harmful (trang trọng hơn bad).

drills.q: Many experts ___ that the new policy will fail. (BELIEF)
a: believe
believed
drills.ex: Cần động từ sau chủ ngữ: believe (trang trọng hơn think).

drills.q: I think that homework is useless.
a: It could be argued that homework is useless.
drills.ex: Chuyển ý kiến cá nhân sang câu khách quan.

drills.q: The government should cut down on plastic waste.
a: The government should reduce plastic waste.
The government should reduce the amount of plastic waste.
drills.ex: Cut down on → reduce (động từ một chữ, trang trọng).

drills.q: Scientists found out that the drug was effective.
a: Scientists discovered that the drug was effective.
Scientists discovered the drug was effective.
Scientists established that the drug was effective.
drills.ex: Thay phrasal verb thân mật found out bằng động từ trang trọng hơn cho văn học thuật: discovered / established.

drills.q: A lot of people believe this. Exercise improves mental health.
a: It is widely believed that exercise improves mental health.
drills.ex: Câu bị động khách quan: It is widely believed that…

drills.q: Prices rose sharply. Many families could not afford basic food.
a: Prices rose sharply. As a result, many families could not afford basic food.
Prices rose sharply; as a result, many families could not afford basic food.
Prices rose sharply. Consequently, many families could not afford basic food.
Prices rose sharply; consequently, many families could not afford basic food.
Prices rose sharply and as a result many families could not afford basic food.
Prices rose sharply, and as a result, many families could not afford basic food.
drills.ex: Từ nối trang trọng chỉ kết quả: As a result / Consequently.
Bị động: could be + V3 → argued.
Evidence là danh từ không đếm được, không thêm s.

drills.q: Use an idiom to describe a busy or easy day.
drills.hint: It was a piece of cake / I felt under the weather …
a: The test was a piece of cake.
I felt under the weather last week, so I stayed home.
drills.ex: Thành ngữ thân mật (a piece of cake = rất dễ, under the weather = hơi ốm) hợp văn nói; tránh dùng trong bài viết học thuật.

participle-clauses: V-ing / V3 / Having V3 …, S + V
preference-advice: had better / would rather / it's (high) time + …
phrasal-verbs-grammar: V + tiểu từ (look up, carry out, put off…)
dependent-prepositions: V/Adj + giới từ đi kèm (depend on, interested in…)

The more …, the more … · twice as … as · by far the …

in order to / so that · so … that · as a result

because of / due to · although / despite / whereas

Thành ngữ phù hợp văn phong

adverbial-clauses: When/Although/Because + mệnh đề, mệnh đề chính

articles: في العربية نعرّف الاسم العام بـ«ال» (الصدق مهم)، أما في الإنجليزية فلا نستخدم the مع الاسم بمعناه العام.
لا توجد أداة نكرة في العربية، لكن الاسم المفرد المعدود في الإنجليزية يحتاج إلى a/an.
present-simple: الجملة الاسمية في العربية لا تحتاج إلى فعل، أما الإنجليزية فتحتاج إلى am/is/are.
relative-clauses: This is the book that I bought it.
This is the book that I bought.
في العربية نعيد الضمير (الكتاب الذي اشتريته)، أما في الإنجليزية فلا نكرره بعد who/which/that.
adjectives-adverbs: الصفة في العربية تأتي بعد الموصوف، وفي الإنجليزية تأتي قبله.
questions: في السؤال الإنجليزي يتقدم الفعل المساعد (do/did/are) على الفاعل.
present-continuous: I am go to work now.
I am going to work now.
بعد am/is/are في المضارع المستمر يأتي الفعل بصيغة -ing.

present-perfect: I live here since three years.
I have lived here for three years.
„Ich wohne hier seit drei Jahren“ → present perfect; für eine Zeitdauer steht for, für einen Zeitpunkt since.
past-simple: I have seen him yesterday.
I saw him yesterday.
Das deutsche Perfekt entspricht oft dem englischen past simple: Mit yesterday, last week oder in 2010 steht kein present perfect.
questions: Vollverben werden im Englischen nicht umgestellt; Fragen brauchen do/does/did.
noun-clauses: I think that he the job will take.
I think that he will take the job.
Auch im Nebensatz gilt Subjekt–Verb–Objekt; das Verb rückt nicht ans Ende.
adverbs-position: Yesterday went I to the cinema.
Yesterday I went to the cinema.
Kein Verbzweitprinzip: Auch nach einer Zeitangabe am Satzanfang folgt Subjekt + Verb.
Das Adverb steht nicht zwischen Verb und Objekt.
punctuation: I think, that he is right.
I think that he is right.
Vor that-Sätzen steht im Englischen kein Komma – anders als im Deutschen.
modals-obligation-advice: You must not come tomorrow – the meeting is canceled.
You don't have to come tomorrow – the meeting is canceled.
„Du musst nicht“ = you don't have to; mustn't bedeutet „du darfst nicht“.
conditionals-2-3: If I would have more time, I would help you.
If I had more time, I would help you.
Im if-Satz steht kein would, auch wenn man umgangssprachlich „wenn ich … würde“ sagt.
countable-uncountable: Thanks for the informations.
Thanks for the information.
Information, advice und furniture sind im Englischen unzählbar: kein -s, kein a/an.
gerund-infinitive: I look forward to see you.
I look forward to seeing you.
In look forward to ist „to“ eine Präposition – danach folgt die -ing-Form.

present-perfect: I live here since 2015.
I have lived here since 2015.
En español se dice «vivo aquí desde 2015», pero en inglés una situación que empezó en el pasado y continúa hoy exige present perfect.
I have seen him yesterday.
I saw him yesterday.
Con un momento pasado terminado (yesterday, last week, in 2019) se usa past simple, aunque en España se diga «lo he visto ayer».
articles: En español los sustantivos con sentido general llevan artículo («la vida», «los niños»); en inglés no: Life…, Children…
there-is-empty-it: Is important to sleep well.
It is important to sleep well.
El inglés no omite el sujeto: hace falta «it» o «there» aunque en español no haya sujeto explícito.
adverbs-position: En inglés el adverbio no se coloca entre el verbo y el complemento directo.
countable-uncountable: I need some informations.
I need some information.
Information, advice, furniture y news son incontables en inglés: sin -s y sin «a/an».
dependent-prepositions: «Depender de» → depend on. Del mismo modo, «casarse con» → marry someone (sin with).
gerund-infinitive: I suggest you to apply early.
Suggest no admite objeto + to-infinitivo: usa suggest (that) + sujeto + verbo, o suggest + -ing.
adjectives-adverbs: Los adjetivos ingleses no tienen plural ni género: different, important, expensive.
comparatives-superlatives: Los adjetivos cortos forman el comparativo con -er (cheaper, bigger), no con «more».
pronouns: Ana is visiting his parents.
Ana is visiting her parents.
His/her depende del poseedor (Ana → her), no del sustantivo poseído como «sus padres».
present-simple: «Estar de acuerdo» → agree es un verbo: I agree / I don't agree (nunca «I am agree»).

present-perfect: I live in Lyon since 2018.
I have lived in Lyon since 2018.
« J'habite à Lyon depuis 2018 » se traduit par le present perfect : l'anglais n'emploie pas le présent avec since/for.
past-simple: I have finished it yesterday.
I finished it yesterday.
Le passé composé ne devient pas toujours un present perfect : avec yesterday, last year ou in 2019, on emploie le prétérit.
articles: Pas d'article devant un nom pris au sens général (pluriel ou indénombrable), contrairement à « les enfants ont besoin d'amour ».
countable-uncountable: Thank you for the informations.
Thank you for the information.
Information, advice, furniture et news sont indénombrables en anglais : jamais de -s ni de « an ».
adverbs-position: I like very much this song.
I like this song very much.
En anglais, l'adverbe ne s'intercale pas entre le verbe et son complément d'objet.
sequence-of-tenses: When I will get my results, I will call you.
When I get my results, I will call you.
Après when, as soon as ou once, l'anglais met le présent là où le français met le futur (« quand j'aurai »).
gerund-infinitive: He made me to wait for an hour.
He made me wait for an hour.
Après make ou let + complément, on emploie l'infinitif sans to (« il m'a fait attendre »).
dependent-prepositions: « Dépendre de » → depend on (et non of).
possessive-case: The car of my sister is red.
Pour une personne, l'anglais préfère le génitif 's : my sister's car.
questions: Pas d'inversion sujet-verbe avec un verbe lexical : la question se construit avec do/does/did.
pronouns: Anna is visiting his parents.
Anna is visiting her parents.
His/her s'accorde avec le possesseur (Anna → her), pas avec le nom possédé comme « ses parents ».

articles: हिंदी में आर्टिकल नहीं होते, पर अंग्रेज़ी में गिनी जा सकने वाली एकवचन संज्ञा से पहले a/an/the (या my, this) ज़रूरी है।
stative-dynamic: have (रखना/होना के अर्थ में), know, want जैसी स्थिति-क्रियाएँ आम तौर पर -ing रूप में नहीं आतीं।
verb-types: हिंदी में क्रिया वाक्य के अंत में आती है; अंग्रेज़ी में क्रम है: कर्ता + क्रिया + कर्म।
questions: प्रश्नवाचक शब्द के बाद सहायक क्रिया (are, do, did) कर्ता से पहले आती है।
question-tags-short-answers: You are coming tomorrow, isn't it?
You are coming tomorrow, aren't you?
question tag मुख्य वाक्य के कर्ता और सहायक क्रिया से बनता है; हर वाक्य के बाद isn't it नहीं लगता।
dependent-prepositions: discuss के बाद सीधे कर्म आता है, about नहीं लगता।
noun-plurals: She is one of my best friend.
She is one of my best friends.
one of के बाद संज्ञा हमेशा बहुवचन में आती है।
countable-uncountable: Can you give me some advices?
Can you give me some advice?
advice, information, furniture अगणनीय हैं: इनमें -s नहीं लगता और a/an भी नहीं।

articles: Bahasa Indonesia tidak punya artikel; kata benda tunggal yang dapat dihitung perlu a/an/the (atau my, this…).
noun-plurals: I have three sister.
I have three sisters.
Dalam bahasa Indonesia jamak cukup ditandai angka atau kata ulang; bahasa Inggris tetap menambahkan -s.
present-simple: He go to school by bus.
He goes to school by bus.
Kata kerja bahasa Inggris berubah untuk he/she/it di present simple: tambahkan -s/-es.
Bahasa Inggris wajib memakai am/is/are sebelum kata sifat, walaupun dalam bahasa Indonesia tidak perlu.
past-simple: Yesterday I buy a new phone.
Yesterday I bought a new phone.
Bahasa Indonesia memakai keterangan waktu (kemarin, sudah); bahasa Inggris juga mengubah bentuk kata kerjanya.
reason-contrast: Although it was raining, but we still went.
Although it was raining, we still went.
«Meskipun… tetapi…» → dalam bahasa Inggris pakai salah satu saja: although ATAU but.
pronouns: My sister said he was tired.
My sister said she was tired.
«Dia» tidak membedakan jenis kelamin; bahasa Inggris memakai he untuk laki-laki dan she untuk perempuan.
dependent-prepositions: «Membahas tentang» → discuss langsung diikuti objek, tanpa about.
ing-ed-adjectives-prepositions: I was very boring at the party.
I was very bored at the party.
Perasaan seseorang memakai -ed (bored, excited); hal yang menimbulkan perasaan memakai -ing (boring, exciting).

ja.title: 日本語話者によくある間違い

articles: I bought a new bag yesterday.
日本語には冠詞がありません。数えられる名詞の単数形には a/an/the（または my, this など）が必要です。
noun-plurals: I have two brother.
I have two brothers.
日本語では名詞の形は変わりませんが、英語では2つ以上なら名詞に -s を付けます。
present-simple: 主語が三人称単数（he, she, it など）の現在形では、動詞に -s/-es が付きます。
verb-types: 英語の語順は「主語＋動詞＋目的語」です。日本語のように動詞を文末に置きません。
there-is-empty-it: Is very hot today.
It is very hot today.
日本語では主語を省略できますが、英語では天気・時間・距離の文にも主語 it が必要です。
ing-ed-adjectives-prepositions: I was very exciting at the concert.
I was very excited at the concert.
人の気持ちは -ed（excited, bored）、気持ちを引き起こすものは -ing（exciting, boring）で表します。
countable-uncountable: We bought some furnitures.
We bought some furniture.
furniture, information, advice は数えられない名詞なので、-s も a/an も付きません。
subject-verb-agreement: everyone, everybody は意味は複数的でも文法上は単数扱いなので、動詞は has になります。

articles: 한국어에는 관사가 없습니다. 셀 수 있는 단수 명사 앞에는 a/an/the(또는 my, this 등)가 필요합니다.
noun-plurals: Many student came to the lecture.
Many students came to the lecture.
한국어는 '들'을 자주 생략하지만, 영어는 복수일 때 명사에 반드시 -s를 붙입니다.
present-simple: 주어가 3인칭 단수(he, she, it)인 현재 시제에서는 동사 형태가 바뀝니다: has, goes, works.
verb-types: 영어 어순은 '주어+동사+목적어'입니다. 한국어처럼 동사를 문장 끝에 두지 않습니다.
there-is-empty-it: Is cold today.
It is cold today.
한국어는 주어를 생략할 수 있지만, 영어는 날씨·시간·거리를 말할 때도 주어 it이 필요합니다.
ing-ed-adjectives-prepositions: I am so boring in this class.
I am so bored in this class.
사람의 감정은 -ed(bored, excited), 감정을 일으키는 대상은 -ing(boring, exciting)로 씁니다.
subject-verb-agreement: everyone은 뜻은 '모든 사람'이지만 문법상 단수이므로 동사는 has입니다.

pt.title: Erros comuns de falantes de português

present-perfect: I live here for five years.
I have lived here for five years.
Em português usamos o presente («moro aqui há cinco anos»); em inglês, algo que começou no passado e continua exige present perfect.
articles: The nature is important for everyone.
Substantivos em sentido geral não levam artigo em inglês: nature, life, money, children.
there-is-empty-it: Is raining again.
It is raining again.
O inglês sempre exige sujeito: use it para tempo, clima, horas e distâncias.
Have many people in the square.
There are many people in the square.
«Tem muita gente» → There is / There are, e não have.
countable-uncountable: She gave me some good advices.
She gave me some good advice.
Advice, information e furniture são incontáveis: sem -s; para contar, use a piece of advice.
dependent-prepositions: She is married with a doctor.
She is married to a doctor.
«Casada com» → married to. Da mesma forma, «depender de» → depend on.
adverbs-position: O advérbio não fica entre o verbo e o objeto: verbo + objeto + very much.
gerund-infinitive: I'm looking forward to see you.
I'm looking forward to seeing you.
Em look forward to, o «to» é preposição, por isso vem o verbo com -ing.
comparatives-superlatives: The bus is more cheap than the train.
The bus is cheaper than the train.
Adjetivos curtos fazem o comparativo com -er (cheaper, faster), não com «more».
pronouns: Maria called his mother.
Maria called her mother.
His/her concorda com quem possui (Maria → her), não com a coisa possuída como «sua mãe».

articles: I saw an interesting film yesterday.
В русском нет артиклей. Перед исчисляемым существительным в единственном числе нужен a/an/the (или my, this…).
present-perfect: I live here for five years.
I have lived here for five years.
«Живу здесь пять лет»: если действие началось в прошлом и продолжается, в английском нужен present perfect.
present-simple: В русском связка «есть» опускается, а в английском am/is/are обязательны.
questions: В русском вопрос задаётся интонацией, а в английском нужен вспомогательный глагол do/does/did перед подлежащим.
determiners: В английском одно отрицание на предложение: not … anything или nothing, а не «не знаю ничего».
sequence-of-tenses: When I will finish, I will call you.
When I finish, I will call you.
После when, if, as soon as будущее время не ставится, хотя по-русски говорим «когда закончу».
countable-uncountable: The news are good.
The news is good.
News, advice, information — неисчисляемые: без a/an и с глаголом в единственном числе.
prepositions: «На фото», «на картинке» → in the photo, in the picture.

th.title: ข้อผิดพลาดที่ผู้พูดภาษาไทยมักทำ

articles: I want to buy a car.
ภาษาไทยไม่มีคำนำหน้านาม แต่ภาษาอังกฤษต้องใส่ a/an/the (หรือ my, this) หน้าคำนามนับได้เอกพจน์
noun-plurals: I have two cat.
I have two cats.
ภาษาไทยใช้ลักษณนาม (แมวสองตัว) โดยไม่เปลี่ยนรูปคำนาม แต่ภาษาอังกฤษต้องเติม -s เมื่อเป็นพหูพจน์
present-simple: ประธานเอกพจน์บุรุษที่สาม (he, she, it) ใน present simple ต้องเติม -s/-es ที่กริยา
ภาษาไทยไม่ต้องมีกริยาหน้าคุณศัพท์ แต่ภาษาอังกฤษต้องมี am/is/are
past-simple: Last week I visit my grandmother.
Last week I visited my grandmother.
ภาษาไทยบอกเวลาด้วยคำ (เมื่อวาน, แล้ว) แต่ภาษาอังกฤษต้องเปลี่ยนรูปกริยาเป็นอดีตด้วย
pronouns: My sister is a nurse. He works at night.
My sister is a nurse. She works at night.
คำว่า "เขา" ใช้ได้ทั้งชายและหญิง แต่ภาษาอังกฤษต้องแยก he (ผู้ชาย) กับ she (ผู้หญิง)
reason-contrast: Although the hotel was cheap, but it was clean.
Although the hotel was cheap, it was clean.
"ถึงแม้…แต่…" ในภาษาอังกฤษใช้คำเชื่อมได้คำเดียว: although หรือ but
there-is-empty-it: Have many people in the market.
There are many people in the market.
"มีคนเยอะ" ใช้ There is / There are ไม่ใช้ have
ing-ed-adjectives-prepositions: I am very exciting about the trip.
I am very excited about the trip.
ความรู้สึกของคนใช้ -ed (excited, bored) ส่วนสิ่งที่ทำให้เกิดความรู้สึกใช้ -ing (exciting, boring)

articles: The sun rises in the east.
Türkçede belirli tanımlık yoktur; tek olan ve bilinen şeyler için İngilizcede the gerekir.
pronouns: My sister is a nurse. He works at night.
My sister is a nurse. She works at night.
Türkçedeki «o» cinsiyet belirtmez; İngilizcede kadın için she, erkek için he, nesne için it kullanılır.
verb-types: Türkçede fiil sondadır; İngilizcede sıra özne + fiil + nesne (+ zaman) şeklindedir.
present-simple: Türkçede sıfattan önce fiil gerekmez, ama İngilizcede am/is/are yazılmalıdır.
questions: Türkçede soru eki (mi) eklenir; İngilizcede ise yardımcı fiil öznenin önüne geçer.
noun-plurals: I bought three book.
I bought three books.
Türkçede sayıdan sonra çoğul eki gelmez (üç kitap), ama İngilizcede -s gerekir.
present-perfect: I live here since 2015.
I have lived here since 2015.
«2015'ten beri burada yaşıyorum»: geçmişte başlayıp devam eden durum için present perfect kullanılır.

vi.title: Lỗi hay gặp của người Việt

articles: I bought a new phone yesterday.
Tiếng Việt không có mạo từ nên hay bỏ a/an. Danh từ đếm được số ít luôn cần a/an/the (hoặc my, this…).
noun-plurals: There are many student in my class.
There are many students in my class.
Tiếng Việt dùng "nhiều", "các" chứ không đổi danh từ; tiếng Anh vẫn phải thêm -s sau many, two, several…
present-simple: My brother work in a bank.
My brother works in a bank.
Động từ tiếng Việt không đổi theo ngôi; chủ ngữ ngôi thứ ba số ít ở hiện tại đơn cần thêm -s/-es.
past-simple: Yesterday I go to the cinema.
Yesterday I went to the cinema.
Tiếng Việt chỉ thời gian bằng từ (hôm qua, đã); tiếng Anh phải đổi dạng động từ dù câu đã có yesterday.
reason-contrast: Although it rained, but we went out.
Although it rained, we went out.
"Mặc dù… nhưng…" → tiếng Anh chỉ dùng một liên từ: although HOẶC but.
purpose-result: Because I was tired, so I went home early.
Because I was tired, I went home early.
"Vì… nên…" → chỉ giữ because hoặc so, không dùng cả hai trong một câu.
dependent-prepositions: "Thảo luận về" nhưng discuss đi thẳng với tân ngữ, không có about (tương tự: mention, emphasize).
there-is-empty-it: In my city has many parks.
There are many parks in my city.
"Ở thành phố tôi có…" không dịch là has; tiếng Anh dùng There is / There are.
ing-ed-adjectives-prepositions: I am very boring in this lesson.
I am very bored in this lesson.
Tiếng Việt "chán" dùng cho cả người lẫn vật; tiếng Anh: -ed tả cảm xúc của người, -ing tả thứ gây ra cảm xúc.
be-am-is-are: "Tôi rất vui" không cần chữ "là", nhưng tiếng Anh luôn cần am / is / are trước tính từ.
a-an-plurals: Tiếng Việt không đổi danh từ khi nói nhiều ("hai con mèo"); tiếng Anh phải thêm -s / -es từ hai trở lên.
prepositions-time-place-basic: I will call you in Monday.
I will call you on Monday.
Tiếng Việt dùng một chữ "vào" cho mọi mốc (vào thứ Hai, vào tháng Sáu); tiếng Anh tách ba: at + giờ, on + thứ / ngày, in + tháng / năm.

zh.title: 中文母语者的常见错误

articles: 汉语没有冠词；单数可数名词前要加 a/an/the（或 my、this 等）。
noun-plurals: There are three book on the desk.
There are three books on the desk.
汉语靠数词和量词表示数量（三本书），英语名词本身还要加 -s。
present-simple: 汉语动词不随人称变化；英语一般现在时，主语是第三人称单数时动词要加 -s/-es。
past-simple: Yesterday I go to the library.
Yesterday I went to the library.
汉语用"昨天""了"表示过去，英语动词本身也要变成过去式。
reason-contrast: Although it was expensive, but I bought it.
Although it was expensive, I bought it.
汉语说"虽然……但是……"，英语 although 和 but 只能用一个。
purpose-result: Because I was tired, so I went to bed.
Because I was tired, I went to bed.
"因为……所以……"：英语 because 和 so 只能用一个。
pronouns: My mother is a doctor. He works in a hospital.
My mother is a doctor. She works in a hospital.
口语中"他""她"同音，但英语必须区分 he（男）和 she（女）。
there-is-empty-it: There have many people in the park.
There are many people in the park.
"有"在这里对应 there is / there are，不能说 there have。
ing-ed-adjectives-prepositions: I am very interesting in history.
I am very interested in history.
人的感受用 -ed（interested、bored），引起感受的事物用 -ing（interesting、boring）。
